sheridan: Hi all 916 first-day check-in. I'm Sheridan (PM, Growth). Two quick blockers: 1) can't open the Growth Figma files (403). 2) need the canonical product roadmap + context on where we keep customer research notes. Who's the right person to add for access and docs?

aisha: welcome! :tada: For Figma, we usually use design-ops or DM me the file URL and I'll invite you. Also make sure your SSO session is fresh.

morgan: added you to 'Design / Growth' team a moment ago. try again and lmk.
sheridan: still 403. link: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZgrow/rdw-growth?node-id=0%3A1
morgan: try clearing SSO cookie or run this quick trick if you're on mac:
```
open "https://accounts.redwood.com/sso" && pkill -f "Google Chrome"
```
then reopen browser.
sheridan: did that, now I can open it. thanks! 

aisha: roadmap is in Notion. read-only for most new hires at first: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Roadmap. If you need edit access ping @robbie or use /access-request.

robbie: hey Sheridan 44b added you as commenter on the roadmap for now. FYI our current focus buckets: Serving-Core, DevEx, Observability. We'll sync priorities on Friday.

sheridan: appreciated. about research — where are interview notes / templates?
aisha: research-playbook + templates live in Notion under Research Ops: https://redwood.notion.site/research-playbook. If you want to run user interviews, escalate to research-ops for recruiting and consent forms.
morgan: i've dropped some interview script examples into the product team Figma + Notion kits. also added you to #prod-research. We'll pair on the first one.
onboarding-bot: Sheridan has been added to: Product Team, Design/Growth group, Research Guild. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: setup IDE, join crits, read playbook).
sheridan: great. one more: where's the critique schedule? would love to sit in this week.
aisha: design crits are Tue 10am PT, Thurs 3pm PT (optional). Join #design-critiques for the calendar invites.
sheridan: ok i'll join. Thanks everyone for the speedy help 44f
